## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text by [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta treats the *Sì tóng zǐ sānmèi* — the meditative *samādhi* of the four bodhisattva-boys — and is one of the major Suí-period Mahāyāna translations.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Jñānagupta's Suí-imperial-bureau activity (587–600 CE).
